seo_desc: Anoka has a big downtown tree lighting with a Santa Shack and trolley rides, plus a holiday show at Heart of the City Music Factory.
lede: Anoka has a big downtown tree lighting with a Santa Shack and trolley rides, plus a holiday show at Heart of the City Music Factory.
celebrates: Anoka's season centers on one big evening. The city's 36th Annual Tree Lighting at City Hall River Plaza fills the afternoon with Santa and Mrs. Claus in the Santa Shack, the 7th Avenue Carolers, food vendors, horse-drawn trolley rides, bonfires and a petting zoo, ending with a countdown to the tree lighting, according to the city. Heart of the City Music Factory adds a holiday show for families on its Anoka stage.
lastyear: The city's Facebook post says the 35th annual tree lighting took place at Anoka City Hall River Plaza on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 3 to 7 pm. The 2026 event is the 36th, and the city again lists Santa, carolers, trolleys, bonfires and the petting zoo, so the program looks much like last year's.
facts: Anoka's tree lighting is in its 36th year in 2026, and the city holds it on the plaza at City Hall. The city calls Santa's home at the event the Santa Shack, and the carolers who sing there are the 7th Avenue Carolers.
trains: Anoka has no train ride of its own that we could verify. Northstar commuter rail serves the Anoka station on its way between Big Lake and Minneapolis. The CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 at 8:45 pm, in Cottage Grove on December 13 at 5:15 pm and at Saint Paul Union Depot on December 13 at 7 pm, with free concerts, according to Explore Minnesota. The Minnesota Transportation Museum runs Santa's Train Shop and Caboose Rides at the Jackson Street Roundhouse, 193 Pennsylvania Ave E in Saint Paul, with pictures with Santa on the North Pole Mail Train, caboose rides, crafts and story time from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the museum.
